name: RemoteVideo

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on interview preparation.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on interview preperation.

variations.context: Preparing for a remote video interview

setting.relationship_dynamic: Candidate troubleshooting their remote interview setup with an agent
setting.background: They are comfortable professionally but inexperienced with video interviews

scenario_template.topic: Preparing for an upcoming video interview
scenario_template.note: User explains the platform and interview conditions

scenario_template.topic: Worrying about technical and environmental distractions
scenario_template.note: User mentions internet, audio, camera, and background concerns
User asks what to test beforehand

scenario_template.topic: Running through a pre-interview setup check
scenario_template.note: Assistant covers technology, environment, and presentation
They discuss eye contact, pacing, and notes
User feels ready for the logistics

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to perform well in an interview but has limited interview experience and can become overwhelmed when faced with unfamiliar questions, time pressure, or uncertainty about how to present their experience.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help prepare for the interview, but tends to overthink answers, double-check phrasing, and seek confirmation about whether their responses are appropriate or convincing.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Interview practice assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical preparation guidance, asks realistic interview questions, helps users improve and organize their answers, provides constructive feedback, and offers alternative ways to communicate experience, strengths, and weaknesses effectively.
